name: Iklódbördőce (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Iklódbördőce (a red and blue shield with a yellow lion, a tree and white ploughshares) above the name IKLÓDBÖRDŐCE in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
